onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to AWOG
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: Your local-first AI team operating system.
onboarding.welcome.point1: Orchestrate agents across sessions, tasks and workflows.
onboarding.welcome.point2: Everything runs on your machine — your files, your keys, your data.
onboarding.welcome.point3: Setup takes under a minute. You can skip any step.
onboarding.account.title: Connect an account
onboarding.account.desc: AWOG needs at least one LLM account to run agents. Add an API key now, or set up OAuth later in Settings.
onboarding.account.error: Could not connect. Check the key and try again.
onboarding.account.oauthNote: Prefer OAuth (Claude / Codex subscription)? Skip this and connect in Settings → Models.
onboarding.account.browserOnly: Connecting an account needs the desktop app.
onboarding.appearance.title: Make it yours
onboarding.appearance.desc: Tune the look and language. You can change all of this later in Settings.
onboarding.project.title: Add your first project
onboarding.project.desc: Pick a folder on your machine to work in. You can add more anytime.
onboarding.project.browserOnly: Adding a project needs the desktop app.
onboarding.project.skipHint: No folder yet? Skip — you can add one from the Projects page.
onboarding.finish.title: You're all set
onboarding.finish.accountNo: No account yet — add one in Settings → Models
onboarding.finish.projectNo: No project yet — add one from the Projects page
onboarding.settings.name: Onboarding
onboarding.settings.desc: Re-run the setup wizard or replay the interface tour.
onboarding.tour.navRail.title: Navigation
onboarding.tour.navRail.body: Jump between Sessions, Tasks, Workflows and your library of agents, skills and rules from here.
onboarding.tour.navSessions.title: Sessions
onboarding.tour.navSessions.body: Chat with an agent in real time — your main workspace for getting things done.
onboarding.tour.newBtn.title: Create anything
onboarding.tour.newBtn.body: Start a new session or task in one click.
onboarding.tour.cmdk.title: Command palette
onboarding.tour.cmdk.body: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) anywhere to jump to a page or session, or run a quick action.
onboarding.tour.settings.title: Settings
onboarding.tour.settings.body: Accounts, models, theme and git live here. Re-run this tour any time from here too.
onboarding.tour.whatsNew.title: What's new
onboarding.tour.whatsNew.body: A dot appears here when there's a new release. Click to see what changed.
